items.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
items.title_zh: BDH-CQ：结合上下文学习与循环潜在推理
items.summary: BDH-CQ combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning, letting inputs presented at inference time continuously update a recurrent memory and solving queries through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space without verbalizing intermediate steps. A 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 at a computed cost of $0.0007 per task, which the authors say sets a new state of the art on the benchmark's cost-accuracy Pareto frontier.

items.title: Tencent's SkillHub Crosses 100,000 Skills and Ten Million Monthly Downloads — and a TRACE Evaluation Layer Is Why Maybe Twenty Percent Still Matter
items.title_zh: 腾讯 SkillHub 技能数突破 10 万，月下载量超千万
items.summary: SkillHub, the OpenClaw-aligned AI skill community hosted by Tencent Lighthouse Cloud, now lists more than 100,000 AI skills and over 10 million monthly downloads, with a TRACE evaluation framework deciding which skills matter.

items.title: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 面向编码智能体的本体锚定项目记忆
items.summary: MOOSEDev gives coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory, capturing architectural decisions, lessons, constraints and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed through an MCP interface, with lifecycle status, provenance and supersession links. On 835 typed records it returned the expected answer set almost fully (0.98–1.00) for supersession, set-completeness and negation questions, versus 6%–27% for a production vector-memory tool's top-k retrieval.

items.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
items.title_zh: 新兴多智能体系统中的模式与问题
items.summary: Anthropic reports that experiments with swarms of Claude agents surfaced coordination failures, collusion and sabotage, and discusses what these patterns mean for AI safety.

items.title: post-graph-rag: A PostgreSQL-Native Bi-Temporal Graph RAG Engine with Temporal Grounding at Synthesis
items.title_zh: post-graph-rag：具备合成阶段时间锚定的 PostgreSQL 原生双时态 Graph RAG 引擎
items.summary: post-graph-rag is an open-source Graph RAG engine that keeps chunks, embeddings, a canonical entity graph and community summaries in one PostgreSQL database, adding validation of extraction output before writing and a bi-temporal layer that records when relations held and when the system believed them. It scores 94.0% on LongMemEval versus 71.2% for Zep's gpt-4o and 60.2% for full context, and 0.807 on ECT-QA versus 0.599, 0.406 and 0.405 published for TG-RAG, LightRAG and GraphRAG.

items.title: Not a Monolith: Lab-Level Divergence in the Cooperative Equilibria of Chinese Frontier LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 并非铁板一块：中国前沿 LLM 智能体合作均衡中的实验室级差异
items.summary: The study compares four Chinese frontier models — DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen3-Max, Kimi K2.5 and GLM-5.1 — in an evolutionary Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma while holding the strategy-to-code converter fixed across labs. It reports that the labs differ significantly in aggressive-equilibrium proportion, from 1% for Qwen3-Max to 9% for DeepSeek V4 Pro, and that within-ecosystem variation exceeds the average gap between the Chinese and Western ecosystems.

items.title: From Numbers to Judgment: Specialist LLM Agents and Reinforcement Learning for European Listed Real Estate
items.title_zh: 从数字到判断：面向欧洲上市房地产的专业 LLM 智能体与强化学习
items.summary: Larix maps a 16-lens European listed real-estate analysis framework to eight lens-aligned specialists and compares monolithic versus specialist-decomposed prompting while holding model, evidence, instructions, schema and scoring fixed. Decomposition improves the numerical-task aggregate by 15.8 percentage points but can reduce judgment performance, while GRPO post-training of Qwen3.5-9B raises the judgment aggregate by 14.2 points and transfers to unseen firms.

items.title: Semantic Graph Unification for Industrial Digital Threads: Bridging 11 Heterogeneous Manufacturing Systems Through Ontology-Driven Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 工业数字线程的语义图统一：用本体驱动知识图谱桥接 11 个异构制造系统
items.summary: The paper presents an ontology-driven RDF knowledge graph that unifies 11 simulated manufacturing sources across nine domains through a five-stage ETL pipeline with automated entity resolution, covering 78 RDFS classes and 108 object properties. Blocking 24 cross-system tools cuts recall from 1.00 to 0.31, indicating that 69% of discoverable signals require cross-system graph joins, and the graph is exposed to LLM agents through 287 MCP tools.

items.title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
items.title_zh: AVA-Encoder：迈向智能体原生的视频表征学习
items.summary: AVA-Encoder works backward from finished films, encoding each into a Film Knowledge Graph of structured-text nodes, typed dependency edges and linked multimodal assets, then regenerating the film with a fixed decoder so reconstruction residuals become textual gradients for dual-loop self-evolution. It improves reconstruction fidelity by 20.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline, and its learned policy beats a finely human-tuned policy with over 70% fewer system-prompt tokens.

items.title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 收敛式绕行劫持：技能型 LLM 智能体中保持任务的资源放大攻击
items.summary: Convergent Detour Hijacking is a text-only attack that uses a skill description to win selection and an aligned instruction body to fabricate dependencies during planning, recruiting an attacker-controlled coordinator and unnecessary benign skills into a bounded detour before re-entering the original route. Across 491 held-out tasks on DeepSeek-V4-Pro the matched coordinator is selected in 80.02% of tasks, and among completed runs token consumption and execution time rise by 66.91% and 92.45% while task completion remains comparable.

items.title: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AaLLM：从拓扑生成到尺寸优化的端到端模拟电路设计框架
items.summary: AaLLM is an open-source multi-agent LLM workflow that turns user specifications into a netlist, covering both topology generation and circuit sizing. It builds a RAG knowledge base from papers and textbooks and uses Designer, Critic and Evaluator agents, reporting 3x–4.5x fewer SPICE calls at inference and 40x lower wall-clock time than existing multi-agent pipelines.

items.title: TeachMateGPT: A Multi-Agent Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Pedagogical Assessment Generation from Science Curriculum Materials
items.title_zh: TeachMateGPT：基于科学课程材料生成教学评估的多智能体知识锚定框架
items.summary: TeachMateGPT is a multi-agent system for generating textbook-grounded science assessments, combining a hierarchical curriculum knowledge base (COPE), a fail-closed staged agent pipeline, and a source-attributed verification protocol (SAVER). It raises faithfulness from 0.68 to 0.96 and answer relevancy from 0.60 to 0.89 over a vanilla RAG baseline.

items.title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: CEDAR-GRPO：面向 LLM 通用溯因推理的过程感知强化学习
items.summary: CEDAR-GRPO is a process-aware RL framework that combines final-answer correctness with abductive rewards for evidence coverage and evidence-to-explanation directionality, post-training four open-weight LLMs on a domain-neutral mixture of hypothesis-generation and hypothesis-selection tasks. It improves every model on all 11 held-out tasks over both base models and correctness-only GRPO, with average gains of 7.4 and 2.7 points and a maximum gain of 30.8 points.

items.title: Where Does Retrieval Fail? Evaluating RAG Architectures for Agricultural Advisory
items.title_zh: 检索在哪里失败？面向农业咨询的 RAG 架构评估
items.summary: The authors build a Bengali agricultural advisory test collection of 1,000 queries and 2,882 knowledge nodes from 284 official publications, then evaluate five retrieval architectures and six embedding models under three language conditions. They find no consistently best retriever: BM25 reaches R@10 0.506 on native Bengali queries but drops to 0.004 on English queries, while dense retrieval falls only from 0.464 to 0.425, and embedding task configuration or passage length can each change R@10 sevenfold.

items.title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
items.title_zh: 发散—收敛推理：通过结构化解答合成扩展测试时计算
items.summary: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning is a two-phase test-time primitive that explores multiple candidate solutions and then reconciles them, which the authors show can amplify correct minority reports where majority voting fails. Recursive DCR reaches 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025 while using about 27% less compute on average than fixed-compute baselines.

items.title: LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset
items.title_zh: LAPF：基于 LLM 智能体的无人机路径规划框架
items.summary: LAPF is an LLM-agent path-finding framework for town-scale UAV navigation that closes a loop over perception, memory, planning and action, reusing prior navigation experience and coupling each detected hazard to a bounded corrective action. Across three trials per method it reaches mean path lengths of 512.83 m and 506.37 m against a 497.33 m straight-line optimum, 17.2% and 15.6% shorter than chain-of-thought prompting, with zero clamp events in both scenarios.

items.title: Valhalla: A Layered Knowledge-State and Service-Governance Framework for Long-Term Scientific Knowledge Work
items.title_zh: Valhalla：面向长期科学知识工作的分层知识状态与服务治理框架
items.summary: Valhalla is a layered knowledge-state and service-governance framework for long-term scientific knowledge work that replaces flat graphs with a five-layer File-Resource-Entity-Relationship-Graph model, preserving provenance while letting knowledge states be exchanged and reorganized across researchers. A Router-Contract-Workflow architecture constrains how language models access, modify and extend knowledge, validated on an antibody-design review task with 26 paper resources, 80 knowledge entities and 92 semantic relations.

items.title: Improving LLM-based Autonomous Web Agents with Filtering
items.title_zh: 利用过滤改进基于 LLM 的自主网页智能体
items.summary: The paper reproduces GPT-3.5 and LLaMA-2-70B baselines on WebArena, identifies common failure modes, and proposes DeBERTa- and T5-based retrievers that rank HTML elements by task relevance. The DeBERTa-based filter raises the LLaMA-2-70B agent's WebArena success rate from 1.97% to 2.96%, and a zero-shot ColBERT retriever reaches 0.52 recall on Mind2Web and 0.47 on WebArena.

items.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
items.title_zh: 训练智能体随其运行框架进化：TaoLive 数字人智能体技术报告
items.summary: The report proposes Harness-Aware Training, which trains compact models to adapt to changing agent harnesses by augmenting skill identifiers, tool schemas, prompt structures and hooks during supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning. HAT scores 94.8 on Live-Stream QA and 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA, and its Taobao Live deployment reports positive online A/B results with P50 and P95 latency of 3.4 s and 8.1 s on one NVIDIA H20 GPU.

items.title: Beyond Decision Boundaries: Relational Geometry Attacks on Contrastive Embedding Manifolds
items.title_zh: 超越决策边界：对比嵌入流形上的关系几何攻击
items.summary: The paper introduces a geometry-aware adversarial attack that corrupts relational structure in contrastive embedding manifolds by pushing positive pairs apart and pulling negative pairs closer, using an offline-trained generator to produce perturbations in a single forward pass. On the Markmatch verification system it reduces accuracy from 95.4% to 38.6% and completely reverses the positive-negative similarity structure.

items.title: Social Chain of Thought: A Multi-Agent Architecture Grounded in Medical Differential Diagnosis Methodology
items.title_zh: 社会思维链：扎根医学鉴别诊断方法的多智能体架构
items.summary: SCoT structures multi-agent interaction for medical differential diagnosis as a multi-round deliberative pipeline and evaluates it against single-agent baselines, one-agent pipeline ablations and best-of-n scaling. The authors report that its recall advantage is not reproduced by monolithic inference alone and is largest on the hardest cases, where multiple rounds of specialist conversation help recover ground-truth diagnoses.

items.title: TraVEL: Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning for Driving-Video Retrieval
items.title_zh: TraVEL：面向驾驶视频检索的轨迹引导视频嵌入学习
items.summary: TraVEL fine-tunes a general-purpose multimodal embedding model for driving-video retrieval, using ego-trajectory similarity as a reward in GRPO because caption supervision alone misses fine-grained motion understanding. Relative to supervised fine-tuning it raises longitudinal and lateral mAP by 9.8 and 4.7 points at 2B, and by 7.2 and 1.5 points at 8B.

items.title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
items.title_zh: 证明是否以那种方式成立？《几何原本》证明的忠实形式化
items.summary: The paper defines five necessary conditions for a faithful formal proof and introduces Pistis, an agentic oracle-guided proof search whose OrderDecompose strategy tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search. Applied to the first three books of Euclid's Elements, Pistis produces compiling artifacts favored over prior work in a blinded human study and an LLM-judge protocol, and uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation.

items.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
items.title_zh: SEER：通过选择性视觉—文本压缩实现长上下文推理
items.summary: SEER learns to select query-relevant rendered text images through visual scanning and to retrieve the underlying text only where needed, combining visual compression with text-based reasoning via supervised fine-tuning on tool-interaction trajectories. On LongBench it reaches 51.11% average accuracy, 2.33 points above the Glyph-9B visual-text baseline and 3.49 points above Qwen3-8B, while retaining average prompt-token savings.

items.title: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs
items.title_zh: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs：为每个智能体提供可写文件系统工作区
items.summary: LayerFS gives each AI agent a complete, writable filesystem workspace layered over shared committed history without copying the base, letting agents work in parallel, commit changes as deduplicated checkpoints, and branch, rewind or merge. It is written in Rust.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.title_zh: addyosmani/agent-skills：面向 AI 编码智能体的工程技能库
items.summary: addyosmani/agent-skills is a collection of production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, published by Chrome engineer Addy Osmani and still trending on GitHub.

items.title: vitali87/code-graph-rag
items.title_zh: code-graph-rag：面向多语言代码库的 RAG
items.summary: code-graph-rag is a retrieval-augmented generation system for monorepos that combines AI and knowledge graphs to let users query, understand and edit multi-language codebases.

items.title: MARC v1: An Open-Source Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical AI Reasoning and Coordination
items.title_zh: MARC v1：面向临床 AI 推理与协作的开源多智能体框架
items.summary: MARC is an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration for clinical reasoning, coordinating extraction, reasoning, answer-generation and evaluation agents with traceable intermediate outputs. It adds a Decomposer that generates task-specific agent prompts from plain language and is configured entirely through YAML, with API-based and local CPU deployments.

items.title: holaboss-ai/holaOS
items.title_zh: holaboss-ai/holaOS：开源 AI 智能体工作区
items.summary: holaOS is an open-source all-in-one AI agent workspace that runs agents such as Claude Code and Codex across more than 100 integrations, MCP, apps, a browser and files with shared context.

items.title: 0xpili/simplified-technical-english
items.title_zh: 0xpili/simplified-technical-english：让 LLM 使用简化技术英语的 Agent Skill
items.summary: An Agent Skill that steers LLMs toward ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English by bundling writing rules, an approved word list and a checking tool.

items.title: MathCode, Mathematical Coding Agent
items.title_zh: MathCode：数学编程智能体
items.summary: MathCode is a terminal AI coding agent that formalizes math problems into Lean 4 theorems and proves them.

items.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.title_zh: Muse Glimmer：面向常驻本地智能体工作流的 30B 参数模型
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open agentic model optimized for always-on local agent workflows on consumer hardware.

items.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
items.title_zh: Show HN：Needle2——面向手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人的 14MB 智能体 LLM
items.summary: Cactus released Needle 2, a 14MB agentic LLM with 45 million parameters at 2-bit compression that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM, decoding at 500 tokens per second on a Raspberry Pi 5 and 300–1,500 tokens per second on VR headsets and sub-$200 phones.

items.title: WeChat's Xiaowei Agent Runs on WeLM — a Sparse MoE Model Quietly Growing to 617 Billion Parameters
items.title_zh: 微信“小薇”智能体基于 WeLM：稀疏 MoE 模型悄然增至 6170 亿参数
items.summary: WeChat has begun gray-testing Xiaowei, a native AI assistant inside the app powered by WeLM. According to Pandaily, WeLM has moved to a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture whose 617-billion-parameter version activates just 23 billion parameters per token.

items.title: Tencent's SkillHub Crosses 100,000 Skills and Ten Million Monthly Downloads — and a TRACE Evaluation Layer Is Why Maybe Twenty Percent Still Matter
items.title_zh: 腾讯 SkillHub 技能数突破 10 万，月下载量超千万
items.summary: SkillHub, the OpenClaw-aligned AI skill community hosted by Tencent Lighthouse Cloud, now lists more than 100,000 AI skills and over 10 million monthly downloads, with a TRACE evaluation framework deciding which skills matter.

items.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
items.title_zh: 新兴多智能体系统中的模式与问题
items.summary: Anthropic reports that experiments with swarms of Claude agents surfaced coordination failures, collusion and sabotage, and discusses what these patterns mean for AI safety.

items.title: Humanising LLM Outputs Is Dumb
items.title_zh: 把 LLM 输出“人性化”很愚蠢
items.summary: The blog post examines signals of shifting AI culture on X, GitHub and Hacker News, including agent skills and AGENTS.md instructions that ask models to answer only in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, and argues that humanising LLM outputs is unwise.

items.title: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.title_zh: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.summary: The article reports that major technology companies are building quality-inspection and evaluation mechanisms for AI agents, so that agents can move from demonstrations into usable real business scenarios.

items.title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
items.title_zh: GPT‑5.6 构建者指南
items.summary: OpenAI's builder guide describes how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents, with guidance on model selection and new Responses API capabilities.

items.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
items.title_zh: 从辅助到执行：企业如何将 AI 投入使用
items.summary: OpenAI research examines how enterprises are adopting agentic AI through ChatGPT and Codex, and how frontier firms are pulling ahead in AI adoption.

items.title: Alibaba Cloud Launches Qwen AI Arena for Real-World Agent Testing
items.title_zh: 阿里云发布 Qwen AI Arena：真实场景智能体评测平台
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud launched Qwen AI Arena, a challenge and evaluation platform for AI agents that builds tasks from real business scenarios and supplies models, runtime environments and evaluation tools. Its first challenge focuses on customer service.

items.title: WPS Quietly Launches Lingxi Pro, an AI-Native Office Agent That Turns Skills into Editable Documents
items.title_zh: WPS 悄然上线 Lingxi Pro：原生 AI 办公智能体
items.summary: Kingsoft's WPS quietly launched Lingxi Pro, a standalone AI-native office agent that makes AI the first entry point rather than a document feature. It is integrated with a WPS cloud ecosystem of 678 million monthly active devices and turns skills into native, editable Word and PPT files.
